1.11 refuses a vehicle whose vehicle chain holds the rider (1.11.2 Entity.java:1636-1641); a cart in the scene has no vehicle of its own (MinecartState has none), so the chain is empty and startRiding goes on as before
the added setPose(Pose.STANDING) is the rider's pose, which MinecartOther does not hold; pick_up mirrors only the passenger link

the added `arg == this.vehicle` refusal cannot fire: the callers pick up only what is no passenger (`!other.passenger` in push_and_pickup_old and pick_up_improved); the START_RIDING trigger is the server's advancement
the added couldAcceptPassenger is Entity's default true (1.19.4 Entity.java:1869-1871), which AbstractMinecart does not override (only Marker does)
the added server-side refusal of a vehicle whose type cannot serialize (1.21.2 Entity.java:2176) does not touch a minecart, whose type serializes
startRiding(arg) becomes startRiding(arg, false, true) (1.21.9 Entity.java:2375): the flag only guards the ENTITY_MOUNT game event and the advancement trigger; the passenger link is the same

push_other is called by push_and_pickup_old only under `release.at_least(1, 10, 0) && picks_up` (minecart.rs push_and_pickup_old) and by the improved path, which MinecartRules::new refuses before 1.21.2 (minecart.rs:142-143): neither 1.8.8 nor 1.9.4 reaches it, so Entity.push's 1.9 isPassengerOfSameVehicle (1.8.8 Entity.java:1024-1025, 1.9.4 :1139-1140) is met only on the 1.9.4 side's form; push_other also asks isPassengerOfSameVehicle by root vehicle from 1.9 (shares_cart, root_cart through MinecartOther.rides_other), so a jockey on the cart's rider is left out as vanilla leaves it
the double square root and the dropped pushthrough are computed by entity_push_impulses_with_pushthrough and push_impulse, gated at 1.17 (entity.rs:128, push_impulse)
the added isPushable guards are entity_push_impulses_with_pushthrough's, gated at release.at_least(1, 19, 0) (entity.rs:134-143) with the pushable flags push_other passes
